entry.content: This is no longer strictly true. I have started using Claude for my personal projects too. There are too many projects that I want to see done and I don't think I can do them all by myself so Claude acts as midwife. Once I learn what I want to learn by doing some project I give it to Claude. This ofcourse prevents me from learning things I didn't even know the project was going to teach me.
